note: Every construction that defeated the witness-context check, from seven independent readings. Each case mutates a real workflow and must produce at least one violation from `sovprompts.audit.violations`; the unmutated tree must produce none. These lived as prose in docstrings until an independent reading observed that one defeat reproduced across three candidates after it had been named, because what refused it was a sentence rather than a case. Each case names the refusal it must produce: an earlier form asserted only that some violation appeared, and one case was invalid JavaScript that fired on the readability branch while claiming to demonstrate scan instability.
